checks.name: original music starts three independent tonal lanes
accepted gun mutes pulse1 without pausing its clock
pause freezes background and old noise while cue74 plays
cue expiry releases its lane and keeps prior noise frozen
resume accepts a new gun and keeps music identity
reset stops old song before replacing all tonal lanes
history gap restores song position and never missed effects
old snapshot and old epoch cannot rewind or replace
unmute resync cannot resurrect stopped playback IDs
native page hiding stops all lanes before explicit recovery
same-ID background recovery restores current music only and preserves source rate
rate-corrected native loop restarts at verified suffix with rate preserved
delayed native media aligns to latest visible voice after load
live terminal 6E replaces all tonal stems with one source-verified complete finite cue
completed terminal cue and duplicate finalized views never replay
global unmute and finalized reconnect cannot replay the finite terminal cue
dispose and late updates cannot restart media

scope: Production Go AudioState snapshots → Contra adapter → platform GameAudio → native Chromium HTMLAudioElement. No ROM runtime, physical-device audio capture, listening or nonlinear-mix acceptance.
